content: Palki shawulu ma' Lya
Shawulu ɗǝ ngalcik mi'bǝlt Lya kali, ti usu tǝn ti tlosi, i' lǝ ma' bali ki bas lǝɓasi,
i' gyebti ndǝgini ki laci lwabati ki gǝlu dopga ki yahudawa ki Dimaskus, gaki nǝgu in a mbi mil bǝlt shitu u mwani nǝ mudli, a mbǝlsi ge' galt ki Ulshelima a kǝndǝsi.
Ti lǝk kǝn ngu, nǝ' ɓal nja ma' Dimasku u, bǝnǝ man tiwasau swai chilton kǝn ngu sul lya ki ga ndǝli nǝti.
I' nda atli i' kum yalon ɗǝ usu “Shawulu, Shawulu ya lakiɗa ki ngalci tǝnɗa?”
Ti kuma i' usu, “Kiwokǝni Mulnalti?” I usu, “Amiki Yesu u nǝ ki ngalcitǝ u.
Amma hilya kǝlǝ ge' gatli, tya ka sǝ dlǝmi' ulnǝ ki pǝli u.”
Ellǝnsi u nǝ si lǝ ne'tu is hol ulki dlǝmi, si kup yali sayen mullan wai.
I Shawulu hilya, nǝ bul dwaɗǝn u taman yeluwai. Is nde' kina is sulti Dimasku.
Muttu maki bǝti ɗa yelluwai, bǝtiɗa ɗamtiwai bǝtiɗa tletiwai.
Mulan ɗa mul bǝlti a Dimasku shinwasi Hananiya. I Mulban shilniti age' dluti i' usu “Hananiya.” I' ndǝgi amingu Mulban.”
I mulban ultisu, “Hilya ki bǝl shitu u nǝ ɗǝ mbeti kitaki, a gyemi a libi ɗǝ Yahuza ko mul Talsus nǝn ki, mul shin Shawulu, ti ngu ɗǝ shilǝn nǝ Lya.
A ge' tlu'ti i' en mullǝn mul shin Hananiya i' zi' toh ga gaki tǝ' yelluɗa.”
Ngonǝnǝgu i Hananiya ndǝgi i'usu, “Mulban, a lǝm mutti ɗǝ kub shilǝn ki muluyi ma' mbalǝn di mbǝli, ti pǝli' mi'bǝtl Lya besǝn lǝɓa a Ulshelima.
In ngu bas lǝɓasi sa bǝlti ndǝti tǝ' gob mus mi' mbe shinwagi.”
Ngonǝnagu mulban i' ul Hananiya su, lǝma' mulna oltu tǝ'dlǝm shin ini ma' ginǝ bǝ Yahudawa wai u nǝ gumsi nǝ mbalǝn ki Isla'ila.
Ami nǝ ga ini an mbokiti toh tǝn mbǝna u nǝtǝ' tle u gaki shin ini.”

Iki Hananiya lǝ i' tege' libini i'zi shawulu toh ga, “Yelse ini Shawulu, mulban kǝn shinǝni, Yesu unǝ peki tǝn shitu u nǝ bǝli u, ti shinǝni gawagi ki yellu ɗa ɗaɗanu, a' nji kǝn nǝ Yal ki mbatl ki Lya ki gunti.”
Alǝbi alǝbi i ulǝn pekki Shawulu ɗǝ dwaɗǝn kǝnǝ kal pǝti, i'go' yellu ɗaɗanu. Iki i' hilya i pǝli' baptisma,
kal ki nǝ' ɗami u, i ndǝltwas pallǝbi. Shawulu a Damasku nǝ Ulshelima Shawulu lǝm mutti a Damasku ne' mi'bǝdl Yesu kal.
Alǝbi alǝbi i' gop dlǝb shilǝn ki Lya age' lu dobga ki Yahudawa, tǝn Yesu yakǝn ki Lya kǝni.
Mus mi' ginǝ kumti is kum gagashinti is ngemi, “Tikǝ mul nǝ dlaki mi' shilǝn nǝ Lya ga nǝ shin u, a Ulshelima u waiwa? Tǝ mbǝnki gaki tǝ' tǝlasi akina ɗǝ bal lǝɓa ki kǝndi.”
I Shawulu mbǝl ndǝtl tǝnki, ti hwotti mbatl ki Yahudawa yi nǝ ɗǝ dǝb a Damasku, ti ussu Yesu tikǝ Almasihu.
Kal ki lǝb mutti i Yahudawa kǝndǝ bi tǝn sǝ' tloti.
Amma i Shawulu kum ulnǝs kǝndǝ u. Gasi nǝ dloncin asi ɓutti dlabi gatli gaki sǝ' tloti ɗa.
Amma a gasi i mil kushtiwas kanti is shimti ge' dǝsi is shimti swage' dlabiwon tǝn dli gatl bi.
Shawulu a Ulshelima
Nǝm mbǝ Ulshelima u i' hilya ɗǝ te'ge' mi' bǝtl Yesu kal, amma mus is kum ɓantwasi gaki sa la'mbatl nǝ ti mul bǝtl Yesu kal kǝn wai.
I Balnaba kanti it tǝlati ma' mi'shinkǝn. Ippisi kan unǝ Shawulu yen Lya tǝn shitu u, i Lya shilǝn nǝti, nǝ kan unǝ' dlǝm shilǝn ki Lya ge' shin ki Yesu bǝni ɓatwai a Damasku u.
I Shawulu dǝm ne'si ati du' ne'si a Ulshelima, a ti dlǝb shilǝn ki Lya nǝ mbatl nǝm age' shin ki Yesu.
Ti shilǝn ne' Yahudawa mil kup bi ki Helinawa, ti shotti bi ne'si, amma is gob ngau shitu ki tlotti.
Nǝ mi' bǝtl Yesu kal mani nǝgu u, is mbǝlti a Kaisaliya is shinti tya Talsus.
Iki i mus dobga ki mi' bǝtl Yesu kal ki atl ki Yahudiya, nǝkǝ Galili nǝkǝ Samaliya i mbi dǝb ki zoki, si pǝtl lǝɓawasǝn nǝ ɓanti Lya, a yal kǝ mbatl ki Lya ɗǝ ɗǝtlsi, is mbǝl tǝnki ɗa.
I dokǝl Iniyasu
To nǝ Bitlus gandǝl atli mussu, illǝ ɗǝ shini' mbalǝn ki Lya mi'dǝb a Lidda.
Alǝbi tǝ mbi mulǝn mul shin Iniyasu, tinǝ tle' ki dli hwon usǝpsi tǝn lumutti.
I Bitlus ultisu “Iniyasu, Yesu Almasihu a ndokǝlki. Hilya ki gadǝl lumut twagi.” Alǝbi it hilya.
I mus mbalǝn ki Lidda nǝ ki atl ki Salona nǝs yentu, is pal temma Lya.
Bitlus tlil Tabita lya ge' mi'mǝshti
A Yapa mul bǝtl Yesu kalon ɗa mul shin Tabita gunǝ ɗǝ mbetti kǝ Dokas ɗaɗanu, ti pǝtl ulkǝ zoki ati ɗǝtl mi'gini bǝ ulǝn nisi ɗawai u.
I' goni immǝci, nǝs uti' malu, is zǝti twage' kǝps ki lya.
Lidda nja nǝ Yapa ɗa; Nǝ mi' bǝtl Yesu kal ki Lidda kumi Bitlus a Lidda u, is shin mbalǝn lop tya ma'ti, sǝ' ngemti, tǝtl dlewti tem ma'si.
I Bitlus zǝga ne'si, nǝm mbǝkǝci u is tolti twage' kǝps ki lya ni. Mudli i nǝ mwani wasǝn mǝci is dlil nja nǝti, asi kulu, asi mbo'ti toh tǝn lu'lǝgǝl gini Dokas pǝlisi teɗi nǝsi ne'tu.
Amma i Bitlus pyakǝlsi mus swadla, in ngus atli in ngem Lya. It juyati temma hwunisi, i' usu, “Tabita, hilya.” Ibɓul dwaɗǝn, i' en Bitlus, ih hilya iddǝm nǝ gǝsi.
It takit toh itl tlǝlti lya. Im mbe mi' ki Lya bi ne' mudli gini mwani wasǝn mǝcu ibbǝlsiti kami.
I gu mandli mus a Yapa, i mbalǝn diɓǝli la'mbatl nǝ Lya.
Illǝm mutti diɓǝli a Yapa a libi ɗǝ mul pǝtl bati mul shin Saminu.
